summary: Bluemount Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Independent Director and Audit Committee chairperson Mr. Ow Kian Jing Dennis, effective August 14, 2026, with no stated disagreement. The board appointed Ms. Zhiqin Lu as Independent Director effective the same day. No financial terms, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed. The change appears routine, not forced; the filing is a standard disclosure of a director transition, which does not constitute a special situation.
